scopeLimits: These are actual standalone diagnostic observations on the two named runtimes, not production worker activation or complete Android compatibility.
Preflight denial applies a decision already made before OPTIONS admission. It does not show that a later application POST callback can undo an earlier preflight.
Complete-first success requires the observed live-owner ordering. The Close-first control still sends the original full upload; an undecided deferral at owner closure remains unqualified.

The real application callback, callback cancellation and ownership, Android cache modes, cached responses, incremental upload streams, stream-read errors and broader worker/profile lifecycles were not qualified.
Redirect denial concerns the final target only. One initial redirect GET intentionally reaches its origin; Android redirect-callback parity is not inferred.
Independent server records include attributable partial requests, with nonempty unclassified bytes invalidating the harness. Aggregate accepted connections are not per-case attribution.
The separate storage crash and its self-test flags mismatch do not erase complete worker observations; worker success does not qualify storage deletion.
No faulting DLL symbol or production crash cause is inferred here from its module name or RVA.
